claim.reason: West elevation vertical dimension chain gives calibrated pixel-to-metre scale: green ticks at pixel y=182 (top of building, absolute z=6.6m) and y=560 (ground, z=0.0m) bound the labeled 6600mm/3600mm/3000mm chain (verified 3600 and 3000 segments match labels within 12mm of scale). The cyan double-door outline on this facade spans pixel y=436.75 (head) to y=563.25 (sill/threshold) at x=608. Applying the same calibration to these door pixels gives head z=2.15m and sill z=-0.06m (snapped to 0.0m floor level, within pixel-line-width tolerance), i.e. door height ~2.2m, superseding the generic 2.1m assumption for this specific West facade door.

decision.reason: Calibration cross-checked against two independent labeled dimensions (3600 and 3000mm segments matched within 12mm); door pixel measurement is a real object outline in the elevation, giving a credible ~2.2m height distinct from the generic 2.1m assumption.

claim.reason: West elevation vertical dimension chain gives calibrated pixel-to-metre scale: green ticks at pixel y=182 (top of building, absolute z=6.6m) and y=560 (ground, z=0.0m) bound the labeled 6600mm/3600mm/3000mm chain (verified 3600 and 3000 segments match labels within 12mm of scale). The cyan double-door outline on this facade spans pixel y=436.75 (head) to y=563.25 (sill/threshold) at x=608. Applying the same calibration to these door pixels gives head z=2.15m and sill z=-0.06m (snapped to 0.0m floor level, within pixel-line-width tolerance), i.e. door height ~2.2m, superseding the generic 2.1m assumption for this specific West facade door.
unresolved: sill pixel gave -0.06m instead of exactly 0.0m; attributed to frame line thickness and snapped to floor level
